ns2:section.sectionText: Non-LIS students and non-dgree students may enroll with permission. 2 or 4 hours (be sure to enroll in your desired amount of credit). Meets for 2 weeks: May 21 - June 1. Required overnight field trip Wednesday & Thursday, May 30 & 31. A $100 non-waived field trip course fee will be assessed to the student's tuition and fees bill. The student will also be responsible for one night's lodging and their meals. Contact the instructor (fschlipf@illinois.edu) with questions or for further details about the course.
